long_biography.plain_text:
An assignment to examine a family group's finances drew Marugán Giró into corporate advisory work. Trained in commercial accounting, he assessed its businesses and recommended changes to professional management. He later spent time in Brazil, where a trading and industrial company named him in an administrative role.

In North America, his appointments extended to laboratory businesses and a Quebec numbered company. Biologie Aménagement B.S.L. named him among its directors, while Near North Lab appointed him to a separate board. He also held a presidency, secretaryship and shareholding in Quebec. A Spanish Hogar Plus directorship ended following a board change.
